blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — It’s Alas Pilipinas men’s team’s turn to carry the flag in the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya indoor volleyball tournament starting this weekend. The men’s national volleyball team, led by second-time campaigners Marck Espejo and Bryan Bagunas, arrived safely in Japan and held its first training session in Nagoya on Friday. Aside from its international stars, Alas has a new weapon in five-time Conference MVP Jude Garcia, who is making the switch to indoor volleyball after successful stints with the national beach volleyball team.
